title: OCT vs IVUS vs QCA to Guide Moderate-to-severe Calcified Lesion Stent Implantation
brief_summary: This study is a prospective, multi-center, randomized controlled clinical trial, aims to assess the safety and effectiveness of Optical Coherence Tomography or Intravascular Ultrasound or Quantitative Coronary Analysis to guide Firehawk stent implantation , and compared the treatment of moderate-to-severe calcified lesion in coronary artery.
